verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.pt: E Zofar, o naamita, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
verses.en_bbe: Then Zophar the Naamathite made answer and said,

verses.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
verses.pt: Por isso meus meus pensamentos me fazem responder; por causa da agitação dentro de mim.
verses.en_web: “Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause my thoughts are troubling me and driving me on.

verses.en: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.pt: Eu ouvi a repreensão que me envergonha; mas o espírito desde o meu entendimento responderá por mim.
verses.en_web: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
verses.en_bbe: I have to give ear to arguments which put me to shame, and your answers to me are wind without wisdom.

verses.en: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.pt: Por acaso não sabes isto, que foi desde a antiguidade, desde que o ser humano foi posto no mundo?
verses.en_web: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
verses.en_bbe: Have you knowledge of this from early times, when man was placed on the earth,

verses.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
verses.pt: Que o júbilo dos perversos é breve, e a alegria do hipócrita dura apenas um momento?
verses.en_web: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
verses.en_bbe: That the pride of the sinner is short, and the joy of the evil-doer but for a minute?

verses.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.pt: Ainda que sua altura subisse até o céu, e sua cabeça chegasse até as nuvens,
verses.en_web: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
verses.en_bbe: Though he is lifted up to the heavens, and his head goes up to the clouds;

verses.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
verses.pt: Mesmo assim com o seu excremento perecerá para sempre; os que houverem o visto, dirão: Onde ele está?
verses.en_web: yet he shall perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him shall say, ‘Where is he?’
verses.en_bbe: Like the waste from his body he comes to an end for ever: those who have seen him say, Where is he?

verses.en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.pt: Como um sonho voará, e não será achado; e será afugentado como a visão noturna.
verses.en_web: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found. Yes, he shall be chased away like a vision of the night.
verses.en_bbe: He is gone like a dream, and is not seen again; he goes in flight like a vision of the night.

verses.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.pt: O olho que já o viu nunca mais o verá; nem seu lugar olhará mais para ele.
verses.en_web: The eye which saw him shall see him no more, neither shall his place any more see him.
verses.en_bbe: The eye which saw him sees him no longer; and his place has no more knowledge of him.

verses.en: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.pt: Seus filhos procurarão o favor dos pobres; e suas mãos devolverão a sua riqueza.
verses.en_web: His children shall seek the favor of the poor. His hands shall give back his wealth.
verses.en_bbe: His children are hoping that the poor will be kind to them, and his hands give back his wealth.

verses.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.pt: Seus ossos estão cheios de sua juventude, que juntamente com ele se deitará no pó.
verses.en_web: His bones are full of his youth, but youth shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.en_bbe: His bones are full of young strength, but it will go down with him into the dust.

verses.en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
verses.pt: Se o mal é doce em sua boca, e o esconde debaixo de sua língua;
verses.en_web: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
verses.en_bbe: Though evil-doing is sweet in his mouth, and he keeps it secretly under his tongue;

verses.en: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.pt: Se o guarda para si, e não o abandona; ao contrário, o retém em sua boca.
verses.en_web: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;
verses.en_bbe: Though he takes care of it, and does not let it go, but keeps it still in his mouth;

verses.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
verses.pt: Sua comida se mudará em suas entranhas, veneno de cobras será em seu interior.
verses.en_web: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
verses.en_bbe: His food becomes bitter in his stomach; the poison of snakes is inside him.

verses.en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.pt: Engoliu riquezas, porém as vomitará; Deus as tirará de seu ventre.
verses.en_web: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
verses.en_bbe: He takes down wealth as food, and sends it up again; it is forced out of his stomach by God.

verses.en: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.
verses.pt: Veneno de cobras subará; língua de víbora o matará.
verses.en_web: He shall suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue shall kill him.
verses.en_bbe: He takes the poison of snakes into his mouth, the tongue of the snake is the cause of his death.

verses.en: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.pt: Não verá correntes, rios, e ribeiros de mel e de manteiga.
verses.en_web: He shall not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
verses.en_bbe: Let him not see the rivers of oil, the streams of honey and milk.

verses.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
verses.pt: Restituirá o trabalho e não o engolirá; da riqueza de seu comério não desfrutará.
verses.en_web: That for which he labored he shall restore, and shall not swallow it down. According to the substance that he has gotten, he shall not rejoice.
verses.en_bbe: He is forced to give back the fruit of his work, and may not take it for food; he has no joy in the profit of his trading.

verses.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.pt: Pois oprimiu e desamparou aos pobres; roubou a casa que não edificou;
verses.en_web: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.
verses.en_bbe: Because he has been cruel to the poor, turning away from them in their trouble; because he has taken a house by force which he did not put up;

verses.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.pt: Por não ter sentido sossego em seu ventre, nada preservará de sua tão desejada riqueza.
verses.en_web: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he shall not save anything of that in which he delights.
verses.en_bbe: There is no peace for him in his wealth, and no salvation for him in those things in which he took delight.

verses.en: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.pt: Nada lhe restou para que devorasse; por isso sua riqueza não será duradoura.
verses.en_web: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity shall not endure.
verses.en_bbe: He had never enough for his desire; for this cause his well-being will quickly come to an end.

verses.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.pt: Estando cheio de sua fartura, ainda estará angustiado; todo o poder da miséria virá sobre ele.
verses.en_web: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress shall overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery shall come on him.
verses.en_bbe: Even when his wealth is great, he is full of care, for the hand of everyone who is in trouble is turned against him.

verses.en: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
verses.pt: Quando ele estiver enchendo seu vendre, Deus mandará sobre ele o ardor de sua ira, e a choverá sobre ele em sua comida.
verses.en_web: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
verses.en_bbe: God gives him his desire, and sends the heat of his wrath on him, making it come down on him like rain.

verses.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.pt: Ainda que fuja das armas de ferro, o arco de bronze o atravessará.
verses.en_web: He shall flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow shall strike him through.
verses.en_bbe: He may go in flight from the iron spear, but the arrow from the bow of brass will go through him;

verses.en: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
verses.pt: Ele a tirará de seu corpo, e a ponta brilhante atingirá seu fígado; haverá sobre ele assombros.
verses.en_web: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
verses.en_bbe: He is pulling it out, and it comes out of his back; and its shining point comes out of his side; he is overcome by fears.

verses.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.pt: Todas as trevas estão reservadas para seus tesouros escondidos; um fogo não assoprado o consumirá; acabará com o que restar em sua tenda.
verses.en_web: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire shall devour him. It shall consume that which is left in his tent.
verses.en_bbe: All his wealth is stored up for the dark: a fire not made by man sends destruction on him, and on everything in his tent.

verses.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.pt: Os céus revelarão sua maldade, e a terra se levantará contra ele.
verses.en_web: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity. The earth shall rise up against him.
verses.en_bbe: The heavens make clear his sin, and the earth gives witness against him.

verses.en: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.pt: As riquezas de sua casa serão transportadas; nos dias de sua ira elas se derramarão.
verses.en_web: The increase of his house shall depart. They shall rush away in the day of his wrath.
verses.en_bbe: The produce of his house is taken away into another country, like things given into the hands of others in the day of wrath.

verses.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.pt: Esta é a parte que Deus dá ao homem perverso, a herança que Deus lhe prepara.
verses.en_web: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
verses.en_bbe: This is the reward of the evil man, and the heritage given to him by God.
